svg.title: 07 Guardrails — Prompt Injection Test Suite + Defense Layer
svg.desc: One process that replays 88 attack prompts and 50 benign control queries through a three-layer prompt-injection defense, keeps the training and held-out sets apart end to end, and grades itself on the held-out rate alone. Every element cites a source line in FACTS.md.

g.text: ① 07-guardrails process (Node ESM · no network, no real LLM)
Per-input defense pipeline — L1 → target → L3
THREE LAYERS — defense.js, in call order
training 59 — the regexes were tuned on them
